title: Air Pollution and Learning
title_zh: 空气污染与学习
title_primary: 空气污染与学习
title_secondary: Air Pollution and Learning
authors: A. Patrick Behrer, Joshua Goodman, J. Parker Goyer, R. Jisung Park
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Nearly the entire world's population breathes air exceeding WHO pollution guidelines, but the extent to which that exposure impairs the accumulation of human capital is not well understood. We study this using longitudinal PSAT data on nearly 10 million U.S. high school students, comparing the same student's scores across attempts preceded by differing air quality and instrumenting for local PM2.5 with smoke from distant wildfires. A year of observed pollution exposure reduces learning by 0.04-0.06 standard deviations, or 14-19% of typical annual score growth. The damage comes almost entirely from moderate pollution days (8–12 μg/m3), below the EPA's historical standard, and from exposure during the school year rather than summer, pointing to instructional disruption as a mechanism. Effects are three times larger in disadvantaged schools and among Black and Hispanic students, who are harmed more by the same exposure. Exposure to air pollution widens achievement gaps.
abstract_zh: 全球几乎全部人口呼吸的空气都超过了世界卫生组织的污染指导值，但这种暴露在多大程度上损害了人力资本的积累尚不明确。我们利用近1000万名美国高中生的纵向PSAT数据对此进行研究，比较同一学生在不同空气质量条件下参加考试的成绩，并以远处野火产生的烟雾作为当地PM2.5的工具变量。一年的观测污染暴露使学习成果降低0.04至0.06个标准差，即典型年度成绩增长的14%至19%。这种损害几乎完全来自中度污染日（8–12 μg/m³），低于美国环保局的历史标准，且主要源于学年期间的暴露而非暑假，这表明教学中断是一个作用机制。在弱势学校以及黑人和西班牙裔学生中，影响效应高出三倍，他们对相同暴露受到的伤害更大。空气污染暴露加剧了成就差距。

title: Does AI Assistance Enhance or Erode Expertise? Evidence from a Three-Month Field Experiment in Patent Drafting
title_zh: AI辅助是增强还是削弱专业技能？来自专利撰写领域为期三个月实地实验的证据
title_primary: AI辅助是增强还是削弱专业技能？来自专利撰写领域为期三个月实地实验的证据
title_secondary: Does AI Assistance Enhance or Erode Expertise? Evidence from a Three-Month Field Experiment in Patent Drafting
authors: David Autor, Tanya Rodchenko, Josh Martin, Zanna Iscenko, Scott Strand 等
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Whether AI assistance builds or erodes professional expertise is unsettled. In a pre-registered three-month randomized controlled trial, we gave 133 practicing patent lawyers at eleven U.S. intellectual property law firms access to a custom AI drafting assistant and measured both their performance while using AI and their professional judgment afterward without it. All work was scored by blinded expert patent attorneys. Paralleling findings from other white-collar domains, AI access raised the quality of work delivered on benchmark patent drafting tasks at 10 days (0.34 SD, p = 0.03) and 90 days (0.38 SD, p = 0.01), with larger gains among junior lawyers. After three months, all subjects redlined an existing patent application without AI, a core task of patent practice requiring expert judgment. Treated lawyers outperformed controls by 0.32 SD (p = 0.04), but this advantage was concentrated entirely among senior lawyers (0.45 SD, p = 0.02). Junior lawyers showed no average gain; their scores instead bifurcated, with sharply fewer mediocre scores offset by more poor and more good ones. The largest gains from AI thus accrued to the lawyers who retained the least. Foundational expertise may be a prerequisite for extracting durable skill from AI-assisted practice.

title: Rural physician program and health outcomes: Evidence and mechanisms
title_zh: 农村医生项目与健康结果：证据与机制
title_primary: 农村医生项目与健康结果：证据与机制
title_secondary: Rural physician program and health outcomes: Evidence and mechanisms
authors: Jin Feng, Qing Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-09-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Primary health care is the doorkeeper for individual health and the cornerstone of universal health coverage. Despite global efforts to promote universal health coverage, the underuse of primary health‐care services remains prevalent in rural areas, resulting in significant health concerns for rural residents. As a part of the policy to strengthen primary health care, the Chinese government has established a rural physician program to deliver immediate and convenient health‐care services. This paper provides the first evaluation of the effects of the rural physician program. We find that although most rural physicians have limited education and lack professional training, the program significantly improves rural residents' health outcomes. The improvement is mainly attributed to changes in health awareness and health‐seeking behaviours among rural residents, enhanced accessibility to nearby health‐care providers, regular health examinations and the diagnosis of simple diseases. However, the program demonstrates limited effect in addressing complex chronic diseases. Moreover, a cost‐benefit analysis indicates that the benefits derived from the program outweigh the associated costs. Therefore, this paper highlights a relatively cost‐effective way to improve the health status of rural and impoverished populations, particularly in developing countries and regions.
abstract_zh: 初级卫生保健是个人健康的守门人，也是全民健康覆盖的基石。尽管全球致力于推动全民健康覆盖，但在农村地区，初级卫生保健服务的利用不足依然普遍存在，给农村居民的健康带来了重大隐患。作为加强初级卫生保健政策的一部分，中国政府设立了乡村医生项目，以提供即时便捷的医疗卫生服务。本文首次评估了乡村医生项目的效果。研究发现，尽管大多数乡村医生受教育程度有限且缺乏专业培训，该项目仍显著改善了农村居民的健康结果。这一改善主要归因于农村居民健康意识和就医行为的转变、邻近医疗服务可及性的增强、定期健康检查以及常见疾病的诊断。然而，该项目在应对复杂慢性疾病方面效果有限。此外，成本效益分析表明，该项目带来的收益超过了相关成本。因此，本文揭示了一种相对经济有效的途径，用以改善农村及贫困人口的健康状况，尤其是在发展中国家和地区。

title: DP20368 Biased Recommendations and Differentially Informed Consumers
title_zh: 有偏推荐与信息差异化的消费者
title_primary: 有偏推荐与信息差异化的消费者
title_secondary: DP20368 Biased Recommendations and Differentially Informed Consumers
authors: Martin Peitz, Anton Sobolev
official: 官方在线 2025-06-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We consider a monopolist selling a product to differentially informed consumers: some consumers are uncertain about their tastes, whereas other consumers are perfectly informed. The monopolist sets a uniform price and can make personalized product recommendations. We characterize conditions under which the monopolist biases its recommendations – that is, some consumers with values below the marginal cost follow the recommendation to buy the product or some consumers with values above the marginal cost follow the recommendation not to buy the product.
abstract_zh: 我们考察一个垄断者向信息差异化的消费者销售产品的情形：部分消费者对自己的偏好不确定，而其他消费者则完全知情。垄断者设定统一价格，并能提供个性化的产品推荐。我们刻画了垄断者偏向其推荐的条件——即，一些价值低于边际成本的消费者遵循推荐购买产品，或一些价值高于边际成本的消费者遵循推荐不购买产品。

title: Employment Impacts of the CHIPS Act
title_zh: 《芯片法案》的就业影响
title_primary: 《芯片法案》的就业影响
title_secondary: Employment Impacts of the CHIPS Act
authors: Bilge Erten, Joseph Stiglitz, Eric Verhoogen
official: 官方在线 2025-12-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine the short-term employment effects of the act. Drawing on quarterly industry-by-county data from the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW), we implement two county-level difference-in-difference designs, the first comparing counties with pre-existing semiconductor facilities to other counties with high-tech industries and the second comparing counties with semiconductor fabrication facilities (which were targeted for the bulk of the CHIPS funding) to counties with non-fabrication semiconductor facilities. Using both approaches, we find robust, positive employment impacts in affected counties. The effects began at the time of the passage in the Senate of a precursor bill, in anticipation of the signing of the CHIPS Act. Our preferred estimates suggest an increase of 110 jobs per affected county in the first design and 180 jobs per affected county in the second design. We also find robust positive impacts on local construction employment. Evidence on total employment and GDP at the county level, as well as on employment in upstream input sectors, is mixed. Simple back-of-the-envelope calculations (which come with caveats) suggest national direct employment effects of approximately 15,000-16,000 jobs in the core semiconductor sector and indirect effects of 28,000-35,000 jobs in related sectors.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了该法案的短期就业效应。利用《季度就业与工资普查》（QCEW）中的季度行业-县数据，我们实施了两种县级双重差分设计：第一种比较了已有半导体设施的县与其他拥有高科技产业的县，第二种比较了设有半导体制造设施（这些设施获得了《芯片法案》大部分资金）的县与设有非制造类半导体设施的县。通过这两种方法，我们发现受影响县出现了稳健的正向就业影响。这些效应始于参议院通过一项前驱法案之时，即市场预期《芯片法案》将签署之际。我们的首选估计显示，第一种设计中每个受影响县增加110个工作岗位，第二种设计中每个受影响县增加180个工作岗位。我们还发现对当地建筑就业产生了稳健的正向影响。关于县级总就业和GDP，以及上游投入部门就业的证据则较为混杂。简单的粗略估算（附带一定条件）表明，核心半导体部门的全国直接就业效应约为15,000至16,000个工作岗位，相关部门的间接效应为28,000至35,000个工作岗位。

title: Great Expectations: Responses to Current and Future Transfers for Low-Income Individuals
title_zh: 远大期望：低收入个体对当前及未来转移支付的回应
title_primary: 远大期望：低收入个体对当前及未来转移支付的回应
title_secondary: Great Expectations: Responses to Current and Future Transfers for Low-Income Individuals
authors: Achyuta Adhvaryu, Jean-François Gauthier, Pamela Jakiela, Dean Karlan
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-02-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: How does the expectation of aid change behavior?We propose a simple approach to separate expectations effects from the direct effects of relaxing resource constraints: compare the promise of a program to the program itself.We test this approach in a four-arm randomized controlled trial of cash transfers in Uganda.Both those who received cash and those promised-to-receive cash increase their labor supply and investment.Immediate transfers also increase household expenditures and savings.Our results are not consistent with standard life-cycle models; they are better explained by a model in which the transfer increases individual labor productivity.
abstract_zh: 援助预期如何改变行为？我们提出了一种简单方法，用以区分预期效应与资源约束放松的直接效应：将项目承诺与项目本身进行比较。我们在乌干达进行的一项四组随机对照试验中，对现金转移支付进行了测试。无论是实际收到现金的群体，还是被承诺将收到现金的群体，其劳动供给和投资均有所增加。即时转移支付还提升了家庭支出和储蓄水平。我们的结果与标准生命周期模型不符；它们更符合一个将转移支付视为提升个体劳动生产率的模型解释。

title: Finding Stars: Mapping the Geography of the World’s Scientific Elites
title_zh: 发现明星：绘制世界科学精英的地理分布图
title_primary: 发现明星：绘制世界科学精英的地理分布图
title_secondary: Finding Stars: Mapping the Geography of the World’s Scientific Elites
authors: Andrés Rodríguez-Pose, Leiboyu Xiang, Neil Lee
official: 官方在线 2025-12-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper presents the first systematic city-level mapping of global scientific talent, analysing the top 200,000 star scientists across 3,635 cities worldwide annually between 2019 and 2023. We use a novel Knowledge Generation Index (KGI) that combines researcher quantity with research impact to reveal extreme spatial concentration in knowledge production. Just four cities — New York, Boston, London and the San Francisco Bay Area — host 12% of the world's star scientists, while much of the Global South remains virtually excluded from frontier research. Beijing's ascent into the global top ten represents a rare challenge to established hierarchies. Our analysis uncovers striking disciplinary variations. Resource-intensive fields like clinical medicine cluster heavily and traditionally dispersed disciplines are increasingly gravitating toward major hubs. Despite these differences, concentration is intensifying across most scientific fields. Even the pandemic's remote collaboration experiment failed to level the playing field. Established innovation centres continued strengthening their advantages while peripheral regions fell further behind. Overall, we find that geography remains destiny, with profound implications for innovation policy confronting widening spatial inequalities in global scientific capacity.
abstract_zh: 本文首次对全球科学人才进行了系统性的城市级图谱分析，涵盖了2019年至2023年间全球3，635个城市中排名前20万的顶尖科学家。我们采用了一种新颖的知识生成指数（KGI），该指数结合了研究者数量与研究影响力，揭示了知识生产中极端的空间集中现象。仅四个城市——纽约、波士顿、伦敦和旧金山湾区——就汇聚了全球12%的顶尖科学家，而全球南方的大部分地区则几乎被排斥在前沿研究之外。北京跻身全球前十，对既有等级秩序构成了罕见的挑战。我们的分析揭示了显著的学科差异。资源密集型领域如临床医学高度集中，而传统上分散的学科正日益向主要枢纽聚集。尽管存在这些差异，大多数科学领域的集中趋势仍在加剧。即便是疫情期间的远程协作实验也未能拉平竞争环境。既有的创新中心持续强化其优势，而边缘地区则进一步落后。总体而言，我们发现地理因素仍是决定性的，这对应对全球科学能力空间不平等日益扩大的创新政策具有深远意义。

title: Resource Windfalls, Public Expenditure and Local Economies
title_zh: 资源横财、公共支出与地方经济
title_primary: 资源横财、公共支出与地方经济
title_secondary: Resource Windfalls, Public Expenditure and Local Economies
authors: Antonella Bancalari, Juan Pablo Rud
official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Can local government spending spur economic activity? We exploit a reform in Peru that redistributed natural resource tax revenues to municipalities in non-extractive areas, generating exogenous variation in inter-governmental transfers. Between 2006 and 2018, we estimate a dynamic cumulative fiscal multiplier of around 1.3, going up to 1.6 in more closed, rural areas. We show that the resulting windfalls boosted public investment, as intended by the reform. Using micro-data, we find increases in labor force participation, wage earnings and revenues for household firms and farms, with the strongest effects in agriculture. Consistent with this, we show that rural areas benefited the most, experiencing rises in income and consumption, and declines in poverty.
abstract_zh: 地方政府支出能否刺激经济活动？我们利用秘鲁的一项改革，该改革将自然资源税收收入重新分配给非采掘地区的市政当局，从而产生了政府间转移支付的外生变化。在2006年至2018年间，我们估计动态累积财政乘数约为1.3，在更为封闭的农村地区则上升至1.6。我们表明，由此产生的意外之财按改革初衷促进了公共投资。利用微观数据，我们发现劳动力参与率、工资收入以及家庭企业和农场的收入均有所增加，其中农业领域的效果最为显著。与此一致的是，我们显示农村地区受益最多，经历了收入和消费的增长以及贫困率的下降。

title: Family-Friendly Policies and Fertility: What Firms Have to Do With It?
title_zh: 家庭友好政策与生育：企业为何与之相关？
title_primary: 家庭友好政策与生育：企业为何与之相关？
title_secondary: Family-Friendly Policies and Fertility: What Firms Have to Do With It?
authors: Olympia Bover, Nezih Guner, Yuliya Kulikova, Alessandro Ruggieri, Carlos Sanz
official: 官方在线 2025-07-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Family-friendly policies aim to help women balance work and family life, encouraging them to participate in the labor market. How effective are such policies in increasing fertility? We answer this question using a search model of the labor market where firms make hiring, promotion, and firing decisions, taking into account how these decisions affect workers' fertility incentives and labor force participation decisions. We estimate the model using administrative data from Spain, a country with very low fertility and a highly regulated labor market. We use the model to study family-friendly policies and demonstrate that firms' reactions result in a trade-off: policies that increase fertility reduce women's participation in the labor market and lower their lifetime earnings.
abstract_zh: 家庭友好型政策旨在帮助女性平衡工作与家庭生活，鼓励她们参与劳动力市场。此类政策在提高生育率方面效果如何？我们通过一个劳动力市场搜寻模型来回答这一问题，在该模型中，企业做出雇佣、晋升和解雇决策，并考虑这些决策如何影响工人的生育激励和劳动力参与决策。我们利用西班牙的行政数据估计该模型，西班牙是一个生育率极低且劳动力市场监管高度严格的国家。我们运用该模型研究家庭友好型政策，并证明企业的反应导致了一种权衡：提高生育率的政策会减少女性在劳动力市场的参与，并降低其终身收入。

title: AI Financial Advice: Supply, Demand, and Life Cycle Implications
title_zh: 人工智能金融咨询：供给、需求与生命周期影响
title_primary: 人工智能金融咨询：供给、需求与生命周期影响

authors: Taha Choukhmane, Tim de Silva, Weidong Lin, Matthew Akuzawa
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We ask a representative sample to write prompts seeking spending and investing advice from LLMs, then simulate the lifetime effects of following the advice under realistic asset and labor market conditions. Applying this method to GPT-5.2, we find following the advice would move respondents toward life cycle theory: broader participation in diversified equity funds, age-declining equity shares, and larger savings buffers. Recommendations vary systematically by gender, prior AI experience, and financial literacy. For gender, two-thirds of recommended equity-share differences arise from men and women writing different prompts (demand), while one-third arise from gender labels attached to otherwise identical prompts (supply).
abstract_zh: 我们邀请了一个具有代表性的样本，撰写向大语言模型寻求支出与投资建议的提示词，然后在现实的资产与劳动力市场条件下，模拟遵循这些建议所产生的终身影响。将此方法应用于GPT-5.2，我们发现遵循其建议会使受访者更接近生命周期理论：更广泛地参与多元化股票基金、随年龄递减的股票配置比例，以及更大的储蓄缓冲。建议因性别、先前人工智能经验及金融素养的不同而呈现系统性差异。就性别而言，建议中股票配置差异的三分之二源于男性和女性撰写了不同的提示词（需求侧），而三分之一源于性别标签附着于原本相同的提示词（供给侧）。

title: End of Apartheid, Not of Inequality: The Slow Transition in a Segregated Economy
title_zh: 种族隔离的终结，不平等的延续：隔离经济中的缓慢转型
title_primary: 种族隔离的终结，不平等的延续：隔离经济中的缓慢转型
title_secondary: End of Apartheid, Not of Inequality: The Slow Transition in a Segregated Economy
authors: Kristina Manysheva, Marti Mestieri, Johanna Schauer
official: 官方在线 2025-07-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Despite the formal end of Apartheid in 1994, South Africa remains one of the most unequal countries in the world. This paper investigates the mechanisms behind this persistence of inequality by developing a spatial dynastic model with heterogeneous agents, incomplete markets, and endogenous choices over education, occupation, savings, and location. Drawing on newly assembled micro-geographic data, we document a shift in inequality from being primarily across races to increasingly within the Black population, with spatial segregation — especially the legacy of Townships — playing a key role. Our model, disciplined by detailed spatial and socioeconomic data, captures the slow intergenerational convergence in education and occupational outcomes observed in post-Apartheid South Africa. It shows how inherited spatial disadvantages — through high commuting costs, disparities in school quality, and limited access to credit — continue to shape households’ educational, occupational, and locational choices, reinforcing inequality long after formal legal barriers have been removed. Quantitatively, we find that removing persistent spatial distortions in Townships accelerates the transition to a race-blind equilibrium by 40% and reduces income inequality by 10%.
abstract_zh: 尽管种族隔离制度在1994年正式结束，南非仍是世界上不平等程度最高的国家之一。本文通过构建一个包含异质性主体、不完全市场以及教育、职业、储蓄和区位内生选择的空间动态模型，探讨了不平等持续存在的机制。利用新整理的微观地理数据，我们记录了不平等从主要跨种族差异转向黑人群体内部日益加剧的过程，其中空间隔离——尤其是乡镇（Townships）遗留问题——扮演了关键角色。我们的模型，依据详细的空间和社会经济数据进行校准，捕捉到了后种族隔离时代南非教育及职业成果缓慢的代际趋同现象。模型揭示了继承性空间劣势如何通过高通勤成本、学校质量差异及信贷获取受限，持续影响家庭的教育、职业和区位选择，从而在正式法律障碍消除后长期强化不平等。定量分析显示，消除乡镇中持续存在的空间扭曲，可使向种族中立均衡的过渡加速40%，并降低10%的收入不平等。

title: Six Years of High-Frequency Phone Surveys: Lessons from Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲六年高频电话调查的经验教训
title_primary: 撒哈拉以南非洲六年高频电话调查的经验教训
title_secondary: Six Years of High-Frequency Phone Surveys: Lessons from Sub-Saharan Africa
authors: Gourlay, Sydney, Ambel, Alemayehu, Wollburg, Philip, Djima, Ismael Yacoubou, Palacios-Lopez, Amparo 等
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-08-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Phone surveys emerged as a critical data collection tool in low- and middle-income countries during the COVID-19 pandemic and have since become a permanent feature of the data landscape in many settings. This paper draws on the experience of the Living Standards Measurement Study High-Frequency Phone Surveys — one of the longest-running and largest longitudinal phone survey initiatives in low- and middle-income countries. The paper examines three methodological challenges central to the sustainable implementation of the surveys: individual-level data collection and respondent selection, attrition, and integration of phone and in-person surveys in mixed-mode data systems. The Living Standards Measurement Study High-Frequency Phone Surveys initiative has provided continuous monitoring since April 2020 across six African countries, supporting more than 120 phone survey rounds and more than 200,000 interviews alongside a parallel system of in-person surveys. The paper shows that survey design choices can mitigate biases in individual-level data collection, although at the cost of interview length and logistical complexity. Attrition has been non-negligible but has not translated into significant sample bias. The paper discusses analytical and survey design strategies for addressing coverage bias and potential mode effects. It identifies priorities for future research, including ex-post adjustment methods for mode effects, high-frequency welfare measurement through proxy-based imputation, and the cost-quality-feasibility trade-offs of mixed-mode survey design. The Living Standards Measurement Study High-Frequency Phone Surveys experience demonstrates that the infrastructure, methods, and evidence base now exist to build genuinely integrated survey systems delivering reliable, timely, high-frequency data at substantially lower unit cost than in-person surveys alone.
abstract_zh: 在COVID-19疫情期间，电话调查成为低收入和中等收入国家关键的数据收集工具，此后更成为许多地区数据格局中的常设组成部分。本文借鉴了生活水平测量研究高频电话调查的经验——这是低收入和中等收入国家中运行时间最长、规模最大的纵向电话调查项目之一。文章探讨了可持续实施这些调查所面临的三个核心方法论挑战：个体层面数据收集与受访者选择、样本流失，以及电话调查与面对面调查在混合模式数据系统中的整合。生活水平测量研究高频电话调查项目自2020年4月以来在六个非洲国家持续提供监测数据，支持了超过120轮电话调查和20多万次访谈，并辅以并行的面对面调查系统。本文表明，调查设计选择可以减轻个体层面数据收集中的偏差，但代价是增加访谈时长和后勤复杂性。样本流失虽不可忽视，但并未转化为显著的样本偏差。文章讨论了应对覆盖偏差和潜在模式效应的分析与调查设计策略，并确定了未来研究的优先事项，包括模式效应的事后调整方法、基于代理插补的高频福利测量，以及混合模式调查设计的成本-质量-可行性权衡。生活水平测量研究高频电话调查的经验表明，当前已具备基础设施、方法和证据基础，能够构建真正整合的调查系统，以远低于仅依赖面对面调查的单位成本提供可靠、及时、高频的数据。

title_zh: 防披露关联均衡
title_primary: 防披露关联均衡
title_secondary: Disclosure-Proof Correlated EquilibriaTitle
authors: Scott Saas
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper explores which correlated equilibrium outcomes are robust to players having the option to publicly and verifiably disclose their private information before playing the game. I focus on outcomes that are disclosure-proof: those that can be induced such that no player is incentivized to disclose their signal. Since signals in this environment do not carry payoff-relevant information, disclosing only limits the ability to coordinate agents off-path. I show that an outcome is disclosure-proof if and only if it satisfies obedience and certain interim participation constraints. Each player must expect to earn more after observing any of their signals than they would in the worst correlated equilibria outcome where they play independently of the other players. For two-player games, this is equivalent to the payoff of their worst Nash outcome. When players can disclose over multiple rounds, all implementable outcomes will be disclosure-proof.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在博弈前，若玩家可选择公开且可验证地披露其私人信息，哪些相关均衡结果对此具有稳健性。我聚焦于防披露结果：即那些能被诱导实现，使得任何玩家都没有动机披露其信号的结果。由于在此环境中信号不携带与收益相关的信息，披露仅限制了在路径外协调参与者的能力。我证明，一个结果是防披露的，当且仅当它满足服从性及某些中期参与约束。每位玩家在观察到其任一信号后，必须预期获得的收益不低于他们在最差相关均衡结果中独立于其他玩家行动时的收益。对于两人博弈，这等价于他们最差纳什结果的收益。当玩家能在多轮中披露时，所有可实施的结果都将具备防披露性。

title: Severity over quantity. Drivers of supervisory capital add-ons in internal ratings-based models
title_zh: 严重性重于数量：内部评级法模型中监管资本附加的驱动因素
title_primary: 严重性重于数量：内部评级法模型中监管资本附加的驱动因素
title_secondary: Severity over quantity. Drivers of supervisory capital add-ons in internal ratings-based models
authors: Beyer, Andreas & Kund, Arndt-Gerrit
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Banks use their internal models to estimate capital requirements in a risk-sensitive way, subject to a set of rules laid down in banking regulation. However, these models are not flawless as the usage of models suffers from imperfections, such as oversimplifications or wrong assumptions. As a result, risks may be underestimated. This is particularly troublesome, where models are used to assess risks to banks’ solvency. In this paper we address an important gap in the literature with regard to such model risk. We find that a small set of high severity deficiencies in models is responsible for the majority of the counterfactual RWA burden imposed by supervisory capital add-ons. We trace the underlying non-compliances to a subset of CRR articles that mostly govern the handling of IRB-relevant data by banks. Our results help improve the supervision of IRB-banks by proposing more efficient use of scarce supervisory resources. JEL Classification: G21, G28, G29
abstract_zh: 银行利用内部模型以风险敏感的方式估算资本要求，并遵循银行业监管规定中的一系列规则。然而，这些模型并非完美无缺，因为模型的使用存在缺陷，如过度简化或错误假设。因此，风险可能被低估。在模型被用于评估银行偿付能力风险的情况下，这一问题尤为棘手。本文针对文献中关于此类模型风险的重要空白进行了探讨。我们发现，少数高严重性的模型缺陷导致了监管资本附加费所施加的反事实风险加权资产负担的大部分。我们将潜在的不合规行为追溯至《资本要求监管条例》中主要规范银行处理内部评级法相关数据的若干条款。我们的研究结果通过提出更有效地利用稀缺监管资源，有助于改进对内部评级法银行的监管。JEL分类：G21, G28, G29

title: Epistemic implications of stable allocations
title_zh: 稳定配置的认识论含义
title_primary: 稳定配置的认识论含义
title_secondary: Epistemic implications of stable allocations
authors: Esteban Peralta
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper uncovers some of the epistemic implications of stability in the presence of one-sided incomplete information. If it is not common knowledge that an allocation is not stable under complete information, the allocation must be stable under incomplete information, in the sense of Liu et al. (2014), regardless of the agents’ information and preferences. The converse does not necessarily hold, so that there can be common knowledge that an incomplete-information stable allocation is not complete-information stable, but is recovered within familiar information and preference domains. The characterization implies that incomplete-information stability is testable and observationally equivalent to its complete-information counterpart, and carries over to other well-known stability notions proposed in the literature.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示了在单边不完全信息背景下，稳定性所蕴含的某些认知意义。若在完全信息下，一项配置的不稳定性并非共同知识，则该配置在不完全信息下必定是稳定的，此处的稳定性遵循Liu等人（2014）的定义，且不受代理人信息与偏好的影响。反之则未必成立，即可能存在共同知识表明，一项不完全信息下的稳定配置并非完全信息下的稳定配置，但在熟悉的信息与偏好域内可被重新识别。这一特征化结果表明，不完全信息下的稳定性是可检验的，并与完全信息下的稳定性在观测上等价，同时该结论也适用于文献中提出的其他著名稳定性概念。

title: Childhood Cognitive and Behavioral Impairments and Adult Health
title_zh: 儿童认知与行为障碍及成年期健康
title_primary: 儿童认知与行为障碍及成年期健康
title_secondary: Childhood Cognitive and Behavioral Impairments and Adult Health
authors: Hope Corman, Kelly Noonan, Nancy Reichman
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use U.S. nationally representative longitudinal data to estimate the effects of cognitive and behavioral impairments in childhood on health in adulthood. We focus on work-limiting health conditions and fair or poor self-rated health but also consider adequacy of sleep, body weight, and health behaviors (use of various substances and preventive health care) as potential pathways. In household fixed effects models, we find that both impairments are strongly associated with having a work-limiting health condition in adulthood; specifically, cognitive impairments increase the probability of a work-limiting condition by 70% and behavioral impairments increase the probability by 60%. Individuals with cognitive impairments in childhood are 43% more likely to report being in fair or poor health in adulthood compared to individuals without cognitive impairments. The effects of cognitive impairments on health do not appear to operate through insufficient sleep, obesity, or health behaviors. Individuals with childhood behavioral impairments are no more likely to report being in fair or poor health but are more likely to get insufficient sleep and to be obese, compared to individuals without behavioral impairments, suggesting that insufficient sleep and obesity could potentially lie on the pathway from behavioral impairments in childhood to work-limiting health conditions in adulthood.
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国全国代表性的纵向数据，估算了童年期认知和行为障碍对成年期健康的影响。我们重点关注限制工作的健康状况及自评健康为一般或较差的情况，同时也考虑了睡眠充足性、体重及健康行为（包括各类物质使用和预防性医疗保健）作为潜在的影响途径。在家庭固定效应模型中，我们发现这两种障碍均与成年期存在限制工作的健康状况密切相关；具体而言，认知障碍使限制工作状况的概率增加70%，行为障碍则使其增加60%。与无认知障碍的个体相比，童年期有认知障碍的个体在成年期报告健康为一般或较差的可能性高出43%。认知障碍对健康的影响似乎并非通过睡眠不足、肥胖或健康行为发挥作用。相比之下，童年期有行为障碍的个体在成年期报告健康为一般或较差的可能性并未增加，但相较于无行为障碍的个体，他们更可能睡眠不足和肥胖，这表明睡眠不足和肥胖可能构成从童年期行为障碍到成年期限制工作健康状况的潜在中间路径。

abstract: This paper constructs the first global dataset on inter-sectoral capital service expenditures. I use this data to disaggregate capital services and intermediate inputs in a dynamic multi-sector trade model. Steady state allocations and responses to shocks are determined by a capital-augmented global input-output matrix. Two properties of the measured network deliver larger long-run consumption gains from globalization than existing estimates, as well as larger gains in more capital-intensive countries. First, more trade-exposed sectors supply capital to more consumption-influential producers. Second, heterogeneity in the network reallocates sectoral expenditures towards producers with larger declines in capital rental prices. These reallocations raise capital incomes and lower consumption price indices.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了首个全球跨部门资本服务支出数据集。利用该数据，我在动态多部门贸易模型中对资本服务与中间投入进行了分解。稳态配置及对冲击的响应由资本增强型全球投入产出矩阵决定。相较于现有估算，该测算网络的两大特性表明：全球化带来的长期消费收益更大，且资本密集型国家的收益增幅更为显著。其一，贸易暴露度更高的部门向更具消费影响力的生产者提供资本；其二，网络异质性促使部门支出向资本租赁价格降幅更大的生产者重新配置。这种重新配置既提高了资本收入，又降低了消费价格指数。

title: The Consumption-Tightness Puzzle
title_zh: 消费-紧缩之谜
title_primary: 消费-紧缩之谜
title_secondary: The Consumption-Tightness Puzzle
authors: Morten Ravn, Alexia Delfino, Andrea Garnero, Sergio Inferrera, Marco Leonardi 等
official: 官方在线 2006-05-02 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper introduces a labour force participation choice into a standard labour market matching model embedded in a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium set-up. The participation choice is modelled as a trade-off between forgoing the expected benefits of being search active and engaging in costly labour market search. In contrast to models with constant labour force participation, the model that we analyse induces a symmetry in firms' and workers' search decision since both sides of the labour market vary search effort at the extensive margins. We show that this set-up is (a) of considerable analytical convenience, and (b) that the introduction of a participation choice leads to a strong tendency for procyclical unemployment, very low volatility of labour market tightness, and for a positively sloped Beveridge curve. These implications are summarized by a linear relationship between the vu-ratio and the marginal utility of consumption that we refer to as the consumption-tightness puzzle given its counterfacutal implications. Moreover, we show that this relationship survives a number of extentions of the standard model and that it derives from the allowance for an endogeneous labour market participation choice.
abstract_zh: 本文将劳动力参与选择引入嵌入动态随机一般均衡框架的标准劳动力市场匹配模型。参与选择被建模为放弃参与搜索活动的预期收益与承担高成本劳动力市场搜索之间的权衡。与劳动力参与率恒定的模型不同，本文分析的模型在企业和工人的搜索决策中引入了对称性，因为劳动力市场的双方都在集约边际上调整搜索努力。研究表明，这一设定（a）具有显著的分析便利性，且（b）引入参与选择会导致失业呈现强顺周期性、劳动力市场紧度波动性极低，以及贝弗里奇曲线呈正斜率。这些特征通过失业-职位空缺比率与消费边际效用之间的线性关系得以概括，鉴于其反事实含义，我们将其称为“消费-紧度之谜”。此外，我们证明这一关系在标准模型的多种扩展中依然成立，且其根源在于允许内生化的劳动力市场参与选择。

abstract: Using administrative data on the largest group of German labor market entrants - graduates from an apprenticeship in a specific occupation - this paper studies the effect of entry conditions on occupational mismatch. Higher entry unemployment entails persistent earnings losses driven by full-time wage effects. Concurrently, occupational matching falls, accounting for 20% of the wage effect. A framework shows that mismatch can arise from cyclical training firm retention or occupation-specific shocks, which I confirm empirically using novel data on occupation-specific unemployment. The findings highlight that specific skills protect graduates from unemployment but may expose them to costly occupational mismatch.
abstract_zh: 本文利用德国最大规模劳动力市场新进入群体（特定职业学徒毕业生）的行政数据，研究进入条件对职业错配的影响。更高的进入期失业率会通过全职工资效应导致持续的收入损失。与此同时，职业匹配度下降，占工资效应的20%。一个分析框架表明，错配可能源于周期性培训企业留用或职业特定冲击，本文利用职业特定失业率的新数据对此进行了实证验证。研究结果强调，特定技能虽能保护毕业生免于失业，但可能使其面临代价高昂的职业错配。

abstract: The relationship between unemployment and the rate of change of money wages in interwar Britain is re-examined. It is argued that improved estimates of the wage equation can be obtained by taking account explicitly of factors which change the level of excess demand associated with the measured unemployment rate. In particular, the evidence suggests that long-term unemployment did not act as a restraint on the growth of money wages. New estimates of the wage equation imply that the NAIRU rose during the 1930s as the proportion of unemployment that was long term was higher than in the late 1920s.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了两次世界大战期间英国失业率与货币工资变动率之间的关系。研究表明，通过明确考虑那些改变与实测失业率相关的超额需求水平的因素，可以获得对工资方程的更优估计。具体而言，证据表明长期失业并未对货币工资增长起到抑制作用。工资方程的新估计表明，由于20世纪30年代长期失业占比高于20年代末，该时期的非加速通货膨胀失业率有所上升。

abstract: We study a two-period commodity market with competitive consumers and Cournot sellers. Without speculation, equilibrium is stationary. A storage-capable, strategically large speculator can profitably create deterministic intertemporal price dispersion using standard order types. A period-1 limit buy order flattens residual demand, induces higher output, and yields a low purchase price. With mandatory liquidation, resale remains below the no-speculation price but above the purchase price, so the speculator profits; consumers gain and sellers lose. With free disposal and a stop-loss, the period-2 price can exceed the benchmark, benefiting sellers but harming consumers.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个包含竞争性消费者和古诺卖方的两期商品市场。在没有投机的情况下，市场均衡是稳定的。一个具备仓储能力且规模较大的策略性投机者，能够利用标准订单类型，有确定性地创造跨期价格差异。第一期的限价买入订单会压低剩余需求，促使产量增加，并形成较低的购买价格。在强制清算条件下，转售价格仍低于无投机时的价格，但高于购买价格，因此投机者获利；消费者受益，而卖方受损。在允许自由处置并设置止损的情况下，第二期价格可能超过基准水平，从而使卖方受益，但损害消费者利益。

abstract: We build a network formation game of firms with trade flows to study the adoption and usage of a new digital currency. In pairwise stable equilibria, we document endogenous heterogeneity and inefficiency in adoption, and explain how changing properties of the currency may increase usage but decrease adoption. We frame the model as a quadratic binary optimization problem and apply it to data. This approach resolves the long-standing complexity issue of network formation games and makes them empirically feasible, as demonstrated with a quantum computer.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含企业间贸易流量的网络形成博弈模型，以研究新型数字货币的采纳与使用情况。在成对稳定均衡中，我们记录了采纳行为的内生异质性与低效率现象，并解释了货币属性变化如何可能提升使用率却降低采纳度。我们将该模型表述为二次二元优化问题，并将其应用于实际数据。这一方法解决了网络形成博弈中长期存在的复杂性难题，使其在实证上可行，并通过量子计算机得到了验证。

title: Toward policy-informed 3D urban land-use simulations by leveraging urban planning regulations: Case studies in Zurich and Copenhagen
title_zh: 利用城市规划法规实现政策导向的三维城市土地利用模拟：苏黎世与哥本哈根案例研究
title_primary: 利用城市规划法规实现政策导向的三维城市土地利用模拟：苏黎世与哥本哈根案例研究
title_secondary: Toward policy-informed 3D urban land-use simulations by leveraging urban planning regulations: Case studies in Zurich and Copenhagen
authors: Somaie Abolhasani, Rafael Ramírez Eudave, Anna Hersperger
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-07-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urban Land-use Planning Regulations (ULPR) are key instruments for implementing urban planning policies. They shape the form and function of urban areas by defining zoning categories as well as building-form and building-function constraints. Their integration into 3D Urban Land-Use Simulation (ULUS) is therefore essential for producing realistic and policy-informed outputs. However, ULPR vary widely across municipalities and countries, and methods for their systematic integration into 3D ULUS remain limited. This study develops a conceptual framework to transform local ULPR into a standardized structure and enhance their applicability in 3D ULUS. The framework establishes a unified classification system for zoning categories and defines standardized building-form and building-function characteristics, specifying what is regulated and how these regulations are applied. Using policy instrument theory, the framework further systematizes approaches to formulating ULPR such as prescriptive, performance-based, or hybrid. Finally, it enables 3D simulations of urban land use governed by ULPR. To demonstrate its applicability, the framework was tested in two European cities, Zurich (Switzerland) and Copenhagen (Denmark), by converting their local ULPR into a standardized format and applying them in 3D ULUS. The results demonstrate that the standardization ensures consistency across jurisdictions and facilitates the integration of ULPR in 3D ULUS. The applications further highlight the framework’s adaptability across different regulatory systems, while also revealing challenges in aggregating detailed zoning categories and translating context-dependent ULPR into comparable characteristics. By providing a structured and adaptable framework, this study supports data interoperability and comparable studies, enabling more policy-relevant analyses of land-use changes.
abstract_zh: 城市土地利用规划法规（ULPR）是实施城市规划政策的关键工具。它们通过界定分区类别以及建筑形态与建筑功能约束，塑造城市区域的形式与功能。因此，将其整合至三维城市土地利用模拟（ULUS）中，对于生成符合现实且具有政策依据的输出结果至关重要。然而，不同城市和国家之间的ULPR差异显著，且系统化整合至三维ULUS的方法仍十分有限。本研究构建了一个概念框架，旨在将地方ULPR转化为标准化结构，并增强其在三维ULUS中的适用性。该框架建立了统一的分区类别分类体系，定义了标准化的建筑形态与建筑功能特征，明确了受规制内容及规制实施方式。基于政策工具理论，该框架进一步系统化了ULPR的制定方法，如规范性、绩效导向或混合型方法。最终，该框架实现了受ULPR约束的城市土地利用三维模拟。为验证其适用性，研究在苏黎世（瑞士）和哥本哈根（丹麦）两座欧洲城市进行了测试，将其地方ULPR转换为标准化格式并应用于三维ULUS。结果表明，标准化确保了跨司法管辖区的统一性，并促进了ULPR在三维ULUS中的整合。应用案例进一步凸显了该框架在不同监管体系下的适应性，同时也揭示了在聚合详细分区类别及将情境依赖型ULPR转化为可比特征时面临的挑战。通过提供结构化且适应性强的框架，本研究支持了数据互操作性与可比性研究，从而推动更具政策相关性的土地利用变化分析。

title: Food Price Crises and the Insulation of Domestic Grain Markets
title_zh: 粮食价格危机与国内谷物市场的隔离
title_primary: 粮食价格危机与国内谷物市场的隔离
title_secondary: Food Price Crises and the Insulation of Domestic Grain Markets
authors: Clemens Hoffmann, Lina Kastens, Alberto Portugal‐Perez, Stephan von Cramon‐Taubadel
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Studies that analyze the transmission of food prices from international to domestic markets for large sets of countries and products assume that price relationships are time‐invariant. However, studies that look in detail at individual countries and products show that countries respond to increasing international food prices with measures that increase the insulation of their domestic markets and thus weaken international‐to‐domestic price transmission. We analyze relationships between international prices and a large set of domestic prices for wheat, yellow and white maize, and rice using a smooth‐transition error correction model. This specification relaxes the assumption of time‐invariant price transmission by allowing price relationships and domestic market insulation to vary over time depending on international price levels. The results confirm that international‐to‐domestic price transmission weakens in many countries during periods of high international prices, such as 2007/08 and 2022. Our findings highlight a collective action problem: as more countries insulate, the global trading system's capacity to buffer shocks diminishes, amplifying volatility and food security risks.
abstract_zh: 摘要 针对多国多产品国际与国内食品价格传导关系的研究，通常假设价格关系具有时间不变性。然而，聚焦单个国家与产品的细化研究表明，各国面对国际食品价格上涨时，会采取增强国内市场隔离度的措施，从而削弱国际与国内价格之间的传导效应。本文采用平滑转换误差修正模型，分析国际价格与小麦、黄玉米、白玉米及大米等大量国内价格之间的关系。该模型通过允许价格关系及国内市场隔离度随国际价格水平动态变化，突破了时间不变性假设的局限。研究结果证实，在国际价格高涨时期（如2007/08年度及2022年），许多国家的国际-国内价格传导效应显著减弱。这一发现揭示了集体行动困境：随着更多国家采取隔离措施，全球贸易体系缓冲冲击的能力持续下降，进而加剧价格波动与粮食安全风险。

abstract: Policymakers frequently implement environmental policies that are less ambitious than what voters would prefer. We document this gap using findings from previous research as well as evidence from climate policy in Austria

title: Importer dispersion and exchange rate pass‐through
title_zh: 进口商分散度与汇率传递效应
title_primary: 进口商分散度与汇率传递效应

authors: Qingyuan Du, Yalin Liu, Jianwei Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the impact of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through. Theoretically, we demonstrate that greater importer dispersion – characterized by larger variations in import size across importers – leads to higher demand elasticity and lower exporter markups, thereby resulting in greater exchange rate pass‐through. Using transaction‐level customs data from Colombia, we provide robust empirical evidence supporting this prediction. The quantitative effect of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through is significant: the importer dispersion channel is at least as important as the traditional exporter heterogeneity channel. Our results are robust to various empirical specifications and become even stronger in the context of the dominant currency paradigm.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了进口商分散度对汇率传递的影响。理论上，我们证明更大的进口商分散度——表现为各进口商进口规模差异更大——会导致更高的需求弹性和更低的出口商加成定价，从而产生更强的汇率传递效应。利用哥伦比亚交易层面的海关数据，我们提供了支持这一预测的稳健实证证据。进口商分散度对汇率传递的量化影响显著：该渠道的重要性至少与传统出口商异质性渠道相当。我们的结论在多种实证设定下保持稳健，且在主导货币范式背景下更为显著。

title: The Effect of the Federal Reserve on the Stock Market: Magnitudes, Channels and Shocks
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_primary: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_secondary: The Effect of the Federal Reserve on the Stock Market: Magnitudes, Channels and Shocks
authors: Benjamin Knox, Annette Vissing-Jorgensen
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We survey and extend work on the Federal Reserve’s effect on the stock market, focusing on three empirical findings: The effect of monetary policy surprises in a narrow window around announcements from the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the pre-FOMC announcement drift, and the FOMC cycle in stock returns. We discuss the magnitude of the Fed’s impact (directional effects or effects on average stock returns), the types of shocks coming from the Fed (pure monetary policy shocks, reaction function news, or information about the Fed’s view of the economy), and the asset pricing channels through which effects emerge (an equity premia for news from the Fed, or changes to yields, equity premia, or expected dividends). We also consider the information transmission (communication) channels. The Fed’s effect on the stock market is large, even for average stock returns earned over periods of several decades. Fed-induced changes to both yields and equity premia play substantial roles, with less direct evidence available regarding cash flows. For stocks, reaction function news appears to be more important than Fed information effects. Communication flows outside announcements windows are important.
abstract_zh: 本文综述并拓展了关于美联储对股票市场影响的研究，重点关注三项实证发现：联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告前后窄窗口期内货币政策冲击的影响、FOMC公告前的漂移现象，以及股票收益中的FOMC周期。我们探讨了美联储影响的程度（方向性效应或对平均股票收益的影响）、来自美联储的冲击类型（纯货币政策冲击、反应函数信息或美联储对经济看法的信息），以及效应产生的资产定价渠道（美联储消息的股权溢价，或收益率、股权溢价、预期股息的变化）。我们还考虑了信息传递（沟通）渠道。美联储对股票市场的影响是巨大的，即使是在数十年期间获得的平均股票收益方面也是如此。美联储引发的收益率和股权溢价变化均发挥了重要作用，而关于现金流的直接证据较少。对于股票而言，反应函数信息似乎比美联储信息效应更为重要。公告窗口外的沟通流动具有重要影响。

title: Breaking Echo Chambers: An Experimental Study on the Willingness to Listen to Opposite Views
title_zh: 打破回音室：倾听对立观点意愿的实验研究
title_primary: 打破回音室：倾听对立观点意愿的实验研究
title_secondary: Breaking Echo Chambers: An Experimental Study on the Willingness to Listen to Opposite Views
authors: Michèle Belot, Guglielmo Briscese
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the willingness to engage with others who hold opposing views, a key and understudied step for reducing polarization. A sample of 2,507 Americans is offered the opportunity to listen to opposing views on immigration, abortion and gun ownership. We find that, at baseline, a large fraction of participants are willing to listen, even without incentives and with an easy way out. Emphasizing common ground increases the willingness to engage and reconsider views on abortion and immigration. We discuss possible mechanisms that can explain increased engagement. We propose that emphasizing common ground increases the value of communication as a means to reason through an issue. These findings point to promising directions for interventions aimed at fostering dialogue across ideological divides.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人们与持对立观点者进行交流的意愿，这是减少极化过程中一个关键但尚未充分研究的环节。通过对2507名美国民众进行抽样调查，我们提供了倾听关于移民、堕胎和枪支管制等议题对立观点的机会。研究发现，在基线条件下，即使没有激励措施且存在便捷的退出途径，仍有相当比例的参与者愿意倾听。强调共同立场能够提升参与者就堕胎和移民议题进行交流并重新审视自身观点的意愿。我们探讨了可能解释这种参与度提升的潜在机制，并提出强调共同立场能够增强沟通作为理性探讨议题工具的价值。这些发现为旨在促进跨意识形态对话的干预措施指明了有前景的方向。

title: Artificial intelligence development and corporate supply chain restructuring: evidence from China
title_zh: 人工智能发展与企业供应链重构：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 人工智能发展与企业供应链重构：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Artificial intelligence development and corporate supply chain restructuring: evidence from China
authors: Xinqi Li, Yun Wang, Jinhai Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Whether artificial intelligence (AI) can enable firms to break free from supply chain path dependence and achieve diversification remains a critical question for reconciling efficiency and security. Using data from Chinese listed firms (2012–2024) and a staggered difference-in-differences model, we find that the AI pilot policy significantly promotes supply chain diversification. Drawing on Transaction Cost Economics and Agency Theory, we show that AI disrupts supply chain lock-in by mitigating internal agency costs, reducing external switching costs, and intensifying market competition. This effect is more pronounced in firms with fewer non-local subsidiaries, a robust internal digital foundation, and those in highly marketized regions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that AI-driven diversification fosters ‘strategic resilience’, it simultaneously boosts total factor productivity and alleviates perceived disruption risks. Our findings offer novel evidence of how digital governance empowers the real economy, underscoring AI’s role in harmonizing supply chain resilience and efficiency.
abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）能否助力企业突破供应链路径依赖、实现多元化，是协调效率与安全的关键问题。基于2012—2024年中国上市公司数据，并采用交错双重差分模型，我们发现AI试点政策显著促进了供应链多元化。借鉴交易成本经济学与代理理论，我们表明AI通过降低内部代理成本、减少外部转换成本以及加剧市场竞争，打破了供应链锁定效应。这一效应在非本地子公司较少、内部数字化基础扎实以及位于高市场化地区的企业中更为显著。此外，我们证明AI驱动的多元化培育了“战略韧性”——它同时提升了全要素生产率并缓解了感知到的中断风险。我们的发现为数字治理赋能实体经济提供了新证据，凸显了AI在协调供应链韧性与效率方面的作用。

title: Lobbying and rotating leadership
title_zh: 游说与轮值领导
title_primary: 游说与轮值领导
title_secondary: Lobbying and rotating leadership
authors: Philippe van Gruisen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Economic and political decisions are increasingly made in international organizations (IOs). A distinctive feature of many IOs is that they operate under a system of rotating leadership (e.g. a committee chair that rotates annually). Despite the widespread use of such systems and their potential value to interest groups, we know surprisingly little about how interest groups respond to rotating leadership in IOs. Using both micro- and macro-level data on the economic performance of commercial lobbyists in the European Union, I show that interest groups respond strategically to short-term shifts in leadership. Specifically, when a country takes over the rotating EU Council Presidency, interest groups increase their use of commercial lobbyists to gain access to policymakers from the presiding country.
abstract_zh: 经济与政治决策越来越多地在国际组织（IOs）中作出。许多国际组织的一个显著特征是，它们采用轮值领导制度（例如，委员会主席每年轮换）。尽管这种制度被广泛采用，且对利益集团具有潜在价值，但我们对利益集团如何应对国际组织中的轮值领导制度知之甚少。利用欧盟商业游说者经济表现的微观与宏观层面数据，我揭示了利益集团会策略性地应对短期领导权更迭。具体而言，当一个国家接任欧盟理事会轮值主席国时，利益集团会增加对商业游说者的使用，以获取与主席国政策制定者接触的渠道。

title: Market Effects of Central Bank Credit Markets Support Programs in Europe
title_zh: 欧洲央行信贷市场支持计划的市场效应

authors: YURIY KITSUL, OLEG V. SOKOLINSKIY, JONATHAN H. WRIGHT
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-05-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using responses of credit default swap indices to European Central Bank (ECB) monetary policy announcements, we isolate a novel credit policy component of monetary policy surprises. We examine how such unconventional monetary policy surprises affect asset markets. Easing credit surprises lead to a somewhat delayed decline in corporate‐bond yields and cause declines in option‐implied measures of uncertainty about credit risk. Easing credit surprises also boost equity markets. Both net and gross corporate‐bond issuance increase as a result of easing credit surprises, with the largest response in investment grade issuance.
abstract_zh: 利用信用违约互换指数对欧洲央行（ECB）货币政策公告的反应，我们分离出货币政策意外中一个新颖的信贷政策成分。我们考察此类非常规货币政策意外如何影响资产市场。宽松的信贷意外导致公司债券收益率出现一定延迟的下降，并引发期权隐含的信用风险不确定性指标下降。宽松的信贷意外还提振了股票市场。由于宽松信贷意外，公司债券的净发行和总发行均增加，其中投资级发行的反应最为显著。

title: Universal free meals and school suspensions
title_zh: 全民免费校餐与停学处分
title_primary: 全民免费校餐与停学处分
title_secondary: Universal free meals and school suspensions
authors: Andres Cuadros‐Meñaca, Di Fang, Rodolfo M. Nayga, Michael R. Thomsen
official: 官方在线 2026-05-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine whether providing free school meals to all students causes changes in out‐of‐school suspensions for schools adopting those policies in the United States. Using updated data and modern difference‐in‐differences methods that account for staggered adoption, we show suspensions fall by approximately 10% in elementary schools and 6% in middle and high schools, with larger effects in schools that previously served fewer students eligible for free and reduced‐price meals in preadoption periods. These findings contrast with earlier null results, primarily due to better methods that account for staggered program adoption as opposed to the updated dataset.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国实施免费校餐政策后，该政策是否导致学校校外停学处分的变化。采用更新后的数据及考虑交错采纳的现代双重差分方法，我们发现小学停学率下降约10%，初中和高中下降约6%，且在政策实施前享受免费或减价餐食资格学生较少的学校中效果更为显著。这些发现与早期零结果形成对比，主要归因于采用更优方法处理交错采纳效应，而非数据更新本身。

title: The effect of reminders for self-set goals on productivity
title_zh: 自我设定目标的提醒对生产率的影响
title_primary: 自我设定目标的提醒对生产率的影响
title_secondary: The effect of reminders for self-set goals on productivity
authors: Martin Abel, Tomoko Harigaya, Michael Kremer, Jessica Zhu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how reminders for self-set goals influence productivity by analyzing data from 10,187 volunteer agricultural extension workers in Rwanda. We elicited workers’ goals and experimentally varied their salience through text reminders. Due to unforeseen logistical delays, approximately half of the treatment group received reminders after completing their tasks. We find that goal reminders received during the regular working period increased a productivity index by 0.08 standard deviations, while reminders sent late had no effect. Further analysis of heterogeneity by goal ambition quartiles reveals an inverted U-shaped relationship: reminders are effective for goals in the second and third quartiles, but ineffective for low or excessively high goals. These results suggest that workers who set ambitious yet realistic goals are more likely to respond to reminders and increase productivity, consistent with prior evidence on externally set goals.
abstract_zh: 我们通过分析卢旺达10，187名农业推广志愿者的数据，探讨了针对自我设定目标的提醒如何影响生产力。我们引导工人设定目标，并通过短信提醒实验性地改变其显著性。由于不可预见的后勤延误，约半数的治疗组在完成任务后才收到提醒。我们发现，在正常工作期间收到的目标提醒使生产力指数提高了0.08个标准差，而延迟发送的提醒则无效果。进一步按目标雄心四分位数进行的异质性分析揭示了倒U型关系：提醒对第二和第三四分位数的目标有效，但对低目标或过高目标无效。这些结果表明，设定雄心勃勃且现实目标的工人更可能对提醒作出反应并提高生产力，这与先前关于外部设定目标的证据一致。

title: Social networks and spread of immigration attitudes
title_zh: 社交网络与移民态度的传播
title_primary: 社交网络与移民态度的传播
title_secondary: Social networks and spread of immigration attitudes
authors: Oleg Firsin
official: 官方在线 2026-04-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates how changes in immigration attitudes in an area spread to other localities. We use the exogenous variation in immigration attitudes from the Associated Press news wire service ban on the term “illegal immigrant,” which previous research has shown made immigration attitudes less hostile in more affected United States counties. We show that respondents in areas more socially connected (via Facebook) to those more affected by the ban exhibited improved immigration attitudes. Additional results suggest the likely channel is changing attitudes in socially connected counties and that people who use social media for political information are more affected.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了一个地区移民态度的变化如何扩散至其他地区。我们利用美联社新闻通讯社禁用“非法移民”一词所引发的移民态度外生变异，先前研究表明，这一禁令使得受影响较大的美国县份对移民的态度趋于缓和。我们发现，在通过Facebook与受禁令影响较大地区社会联系更紧密的区域，受访者的移民态度有所改善。进一步结果表明，可能的传导机制是社会联系紧密县份的态度变化，且通过社交媒体获取政治信息的人群受影响更为显著。

title: A uniformly valid test for instrument exogeneity
title_zh: 工具变量外生性的一致有效检验
title_primary: 工具变量外生性的一致有效检验
title_secondary: A uniformly valid test for instrument exogeneity
authors: Prosper Dovonon, Nikolay Gospodinov
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the limiting behavior of the test for instrument exogeneity in linear models when there is uncertainty about the strength of the identification signal. We consider the test for conditional moment restrictions with an expanding set of constructed instruments. We establish the uniform validity of the standard normal asymptotic approximation, under the null, of this specification test over all possible degrees of model identification. As a result, this allows the researcher to use standard inference for testing instrument exogeneity without the need of any prior knowledge if the instruments are strong, semi-strong, weak or completely irrelevant. Furthermore, we show that the test is consistent regardless of the instrument strength; i.e., even in cases (weak and completely irrelevant instruments) where the standard tests fail to exhibit asymptotic power. To obtain these results, we characterize the rate of the estimator under a drifting sequence for the identification signal. We illustrate the appealing properties of the test in simulations and an empirical application.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当识别信号强度存在不确定性时，线性模型中工具变量外生性检验的极限行为。我们考虑在构造工具变量集不断扩大的情况下，对条件矩约束进行检验。我们确立了在原假设下，该设定检验的标准正态渐近近似在所有可能的模型识别程度上均具有统一有效性。因此，这使得研究者无需事先了解工具变量是强、半强、弱还是完全不相关，即可使用标准推断来检验工具外生性。此外，我们证明无论工具强度如何，该检验都是一致的；即，即使在标准检验无法展现渐近功效的情况下（如弱工具和完全不相关工具），该检验依然有效。为获得这些结果，我们刻画了在识别信号漂移序列下估计量的速率。我们通过模拟和实证应用展示了该检验的优良性质。

title: Sustainable consumption and the economic well‐being of American households
title_zh: 可持续消费与美国家庭的经济福祉
title_primary: 可持续消费与美国家庭的经济福祉
title_secondary: Sustainable consumption and the economic well‐being of American households
authors: Daniel H. Cooper, Barry Z. Cynamon, Steven M. Fazzari
official: 官方在线 2026-03-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: “Sustainable consumption” defines a comprehensive measure of household economic well-being that integrates income, assets, debt, transfers, and rates of return to estimate a feasible lifetime consumption path. We find that sustainable consumption anchors actual spending, with deviations in one period adjusting back toward the sustainable level in subsequent periods. After the Great Recession, sustainable consumption fell more than actual consumption, in part due to lower real asset returns. Decomposing sustainable consumption into its components reveals primary support from taxable income, but its share has declined while Social Security's has grown. Substantial differences are also evident across race-ethnicity and educational levels.
abstract_zh: 可持续消费”定义了一种综合衡量家庭经济福祉的指标，该指标整合了收入、资产、债务、转移支付及回报率，以估算可行的终身消费路径。我们发现，可持续消费锚定实际支出，某一时期的偏离会在后续时期调整回可持续水平。大衰退后，可持续消费的下降幅度超过实际消费，部分原因在于实际资产回报率降低。将可持续消费分解为其组成部分，显示其主要支撑来自应税收入，但其占比已下降，而社会保障的占比则有所增长。在种族-民族及教育水平之间，也呈现出显著差异。

title: Equivalence between tying and vertical integration with Pareto‐improving foreclosure
title_zh: 捆绑销售与纵向一体化在帕累托改进式排他中的等价性
title_primary: 捆绑销售与纵向一体化在帕累托改进式排他中的等价性
title_secondary: Equivalence between tying and vertical integration with Pareto‐improving foreclosure
authors: Yong Chao, Babu Nahata
official: 官方在线 2026-03-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper explores the relationships among tying, partial integration (PI), and full integration (FI) when an input monopolist can require downstream buyers to purchase a competitively supplied input from it (tying) or integrate forward in the downstream market. Both tying and integration foreclose the independent supply of the other input, yet we show that tying and PI are always equivalent in equilibrium, even under general production technologies—extending Blair and Kaserman, who focus on FI and linearly homogeneous production. In contrast, tying and FI are not always equivalent; we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for their equivalence and show that, when nonequivalent, tying can generate higher total welfare than FI. We also identify conditions under which either practice can be Pareto improving relative to the non-tying/non-integration benchmark. These findings contribute to the economic foundation for evaluating tying and integration in antitrust policy.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当投入品垄断者能够要求下游购买者从其处购买竞争性供应的投入品（捆绑销售）或在下游市场进行前向整合（FI）时，捆绑销售、部分整合（PI）与完全整合（FI）之间的关系。捆绑销售与整合均会排挤其他投入品的独立供应，然而我们证明，即使是在一般生产技术条件下，捆绑销售与PI在均衡中始终等价——这一结论扩展了Blair和Kaserman的研究，后者主要关注FI及线性齐次生产。相比之下，捆绑销售与FI并非总是等价；我们推导出二者等价的必要且充分条件，并表明在不等价的情况下，捆绑销售可能比FI带来更高的总福利。我们还识别了在何种条件下，这两种做法相对于非捆绑/非整合基准情形可以实现帕累托改进。这些发现为反垄断政策中评估捆绑销售与整合提供了经济学基础。

title: Ownership Dynamics and Firm Policies with a Large Shareholder
title_zh: 大股东持股下的所有权动态与企业政策
title_primary: 大股东持股下的所有权动态与企业政策
title_secondary: Ownership Dynamics and Firm Policies with a Large Shareholder
authors: Advisory Board, Sebastian Gryglewicz, Simon Mayer, Erwan Morellec
official: 官方在线 2026-02-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of large shareholders and firm policies, where a blockholder engages with the firm to improve asset productivity and influence decisions on investment, financing, and executive compensation. In equilibrium, the blockholder’s ownership stake may grow or shrink over time driven by gains from trade that result from the relationship between ownership, corporate policies, and control. A feedback loop emerges: as the blockholder increases their ownership, it boosts investment and the firm's debt capacity, while higher returns from debt and investment incentivize the blockholder to increase their stake. While firm policies need not maximize dispersed shareholder value when the blockholder is in control, limiting blockholder influence ultimately reduces blockholder ownership and firm value.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于大股东与企业政策动态关系的理论模型。在该模型中，大宗持股者通过参与公司治理提升资产生产率，并影响投资、融资及高管薪酬等决策。在均衡状态下，大宗持股者的所有权份额会随时间推移而增减，这种变化源于所有权结构、企业政策与控制权之间的交易收益关系。由此形成反馈循环：当大宗持股者增持股份时，会促进投资并提升企业债务容量，而债务与投资带来的更高回报又激励其进一步增持。尽管在大宗持股者控制下，企业政策未必能最大化分散股东价值，但限制其影响力最终将导致持股比例下降与企业价值受损。

title: Consumer response to environmental standards: Evidence from gasoline regulation in China
title_zh: 消费者对环境标准的反应：来自中国汽油管制的证据
title_primary: 消费者对环境标准的反应：来自中国汽油管制的证据
title_secondary: Consumer response to environmental standards: Evidence from gasoline regulation in China
authors: Yucheng Wang, Lei Zhang, Liyang Zhou
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In this paper, we study the effects of gasoline content regulations on consumers’ product choices in China. Our empirical design leverages a unique market structure and policy-induced changes in gasoline standards. Using detailed station-level data, we compare sales volumes of gas stations located near city borders before and after one side’s government implements stricter gasoline standards, which raise both the price and quality of gasoline. We find that the relative market share of stations located on the side implementing stricter standards increases, and we recover consumers’ underlying preference for higher fuel quality. Based on the estimated demand, the marginal willingness to pay (MWTP) for the upgrade from China III to China IV gasoline standards is approximately 5.2% of the retail price. Our simulation shows that government subsidies for the upgraded gasoline product create unintended behavioral distortions, which diminish the overall environmental benefits and welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了汽油含量监管对中国消费者产品选择的影响。我们的实证设计利用了独特的市场结构和政策引发的汽油标准变化。利用详细的加油站层面数据，我们比较了城市边界两侧加油站在一侧政府实施更严格汽油标准前后的销售量，该标准同时提高了汽油的价格和质量。我们发现，实施更严格标准一侧的加油站的相对市场份额有所增加，并据此恢复了消费者对更高燃油质量的潜在偏好。基于估计的需求，从中国III到中国IV汽油标准升级的边际支付意愿（MWTP）约为零售价格的5.2%。我们的模拟显示，政府对升级汽油产品的补贴造成了非预期的行为扭曲，削弱了整体环境效益和福利收益。

title: Keeping up with the Joneses? The rise of modern universities and local economic development in Italy
title_zh: 追赶琼斯？现代大学的兴起与意大利地方经济发展
title_primary: 追赶琼斯？现代大学的兴起与意大利地方经济发展
title_secondary: Keeping up with the Joneses? The rise of modern universities and local economic development in Italy
authors: Elena Cottini, Paolo Ghinetti, Simone Moriconi
official: 官方在线 2026-01-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper uses own built historical register tracing the evolution of Italian higher education from the High Middle Ages to 2010 to analyse the economic effects of the rise of modern universities. The registry data prompts the creation of a panel dataset measuring higher education supply across 110 Italian provinces from 1870 to 2010, which corresponds to the transition from elite to mass higher education in Italy. Our econometric approach combines a fixed effects estimator with Bartik-style instruments that exploit the historical cross-province distribution of higher education institutions in Italy. We find significant economic returns of universities, particularly in synergy with industrialisation, contributing to Italy’s transition to sustained growth. Our estimates predict that a province exposed to an average supply (equivalent to 7 universities, approximately) experiences an annual 2% increase in real gross value added per capita compared to a province with a zero supply. We show that about two thirds of these returns arise locally, while the remaining third originates from externalities. We argue that such high local concentration of economic returns contribute to fostering inequalities between small peripheral areas and large university hubs. Similar content being viewed by others
abstract_zh: 本文利用自建的历史登记册，追溯意大利高等教育从中世纪盛期至2010年的演变历程，分析现代大学兴起的经济效应。该登记册数据构建了一个面板数据集，用于衡量1870年至2010年间意大利110个省份的高等教育供给，这一时期对应意大利从精英教育向大众教育的转型。我们的计量方法结合了固定效应估计量与巴蒂克式工具变量，后者利用了意大利各省份高等教育机构的历史分布差异。研究发现，大学具有显著的经济回报，尤其在与工业化协同作用时，推动了意大利向持续增长的转型。我们的估计预测，与零供给的省份相比，面临平均供给（约相当于7所大学）的省份，其人均实际总增加值每年增长2%。我们表明，这些回报中约三分之二产生于本地，其余三分之一源于外部性。我们认为，这种经济回报的高度本地集中加剧了小型边缘地区与大型大学中心之间的不平等。类似内容被其他读者阅读。

title: Insiders’ Information Advantage: Evidence from Competition with Short Sellers
title_zh: 内部人信息优势：来自与卖空者竞争的证据
title_primary: 内部人信息优势：来自与卖空者竞争的证据
title_secondary: Insiders’ Information Advantage: Evidence from Competition with Short Sellers
authors: Contreras, Harold, Fidrmuc, Jana P., Kozhan 等
source: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
official: 官方在线 2025-10-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the information content of corporate insiders’ trades after earnings announcements. We find little evidence that insiders trade on foreknowledge of material information in the post-SOX period. Conditioning on short-selling activity as a proxy for demand of arbitrageurs who exploit short-term mispricing, we show that insiders profit from selling because of their ability to exploit short-term mispricing after earnings releases. In contrast before SOX, insiders do take advantage of foreknowledge of material information while selling. Insider purchases are based on foreknowledge of material information both before and after SOX, but they are rare and have small economic magnitude.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业内幕人士在盈余公告后交易的信息含量。在萨班斯-奥克斯利法案（SOX）之后的时期，我们几乎没有发现内幕人士利用重大信息预知进行交易的证据。以卖空活动作为利用短期错误定价的套利者需求代理指标，我们表明，内幕人士之所以能从卖出中获利，是因为他们有能力在盈余发布后利用短期错误定价。相比之下，在SOX之前，内幕人士在卖出时确实利用了重大信息的预知优势。内幕买入在SOX前后均基于重大信息的预知，但此类交易稀少且经济规模较小。

title: Factor exposures of hedge fund strategies and unconventional monetary policy shocks
title_primary: Factor exposures of hedge fund strategies and unconventional monetary policy shocks
authors: Massimo Guidolin, Alexei G. Orlov
official: 官方在线 2025-10-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study whether and how the performance and factor exposures of the hedge fund (HF) industry as a whole and of 10 common HF strategies have been affected by unconventional monetary policy (UMP) announcements by the Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank. Using event studies, we find that UMP announcements are a highly significant risk exposure shifter for Dedicated Short Bias, Equity Market Neutral, Event Driven, and Multi-Strategy strategies as well as the aggregate HF index. We further show that the UMP affects HFs’ performance through significant changes in the betas of conventional HF risk factors. Our results for the aggregate and style indices are corroborated by an augmented Fama-French five-factor model, tests for breaks in US and Eurozone shadow rates, and analyses of more granular individual HF data.

title: Impact of industrial agglomeration on total factor productivity in the context of embedded global value chains
title_zh: 嵌入全球价值链背景下产业集聚对全要素生产率的影响
title_primary: 嵌入全球价值链背景下产业集聚对全要素生产率的影响
title_secondary: Impact of industrial agglomeration on total factor productivity in the context of embedded global value chains
authors: Ding Xiangzhong Aviral Kumar Tiwari Roni Bhowmik a The Institute for Sustainable Development, Macau University of Science and Technology, Macau, Chinab Indian Institute of Management Bodh Gaya, Bodh Gaya, Indiac School of Business 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines how industrial agglomeration interacts with global value chains (GVCs) integration to affect total factor productivity (TFP) in China. Using panel data from 30 provinces between 2011 and 2020, we find that agglomeration alone is associated with lower TFP, likely due to congestion and resource misallocation. However, when embedded in GVCs, agglomeration exerts a positive and significant impact on productivity. Mechanism analysis reveals that innovation capacity and industrial competitiveness enhance this effect, especially in regions with high GVC value-added. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that GVC participation amplifies agglomeration’s productivity benefits in high-agglomeration regions, but not in low-agglomeration ones. These findings highlight the need for region-specific policies that promote GVC upgrading, foster innovation and strengthen industrial linkages to support high-quality development.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了产业集聚与全球价值链（GVCs）整合如何相互作用，进而影响中国的全要素生产率（TFP）。基于2011年至2020年间30个省份的面板数据，我们发现，集聚本身与较低的全要素生产率相关，这可能是由于拥挤效应和资源配置不当所致。然而，当嵌入全球价值链时，集聚对生产率产生了积极且显著的影响。机制分析揭示，创新能力与产业竞争力增强了这一效应，尤其是在全球价值链附加值较高的地区。异质性分析进一步表明，全球价值链参与在高集聚地区放大了集聚的生产率收益，但在低集聚地区则不然。这些发现强调了制定区域特定政策的必要性，以促进全球价值链升级、激发创新并强化产业联系，从而支持高质量发展。
